lines.text: Reward: Gem ×50

lines.speaker: stationery
lines.text: Thankyou.

lines.speaker: stationery
lines.text: The robot arrived safelywith all ofour items intow.

lines.speaker: stationery
lines.text: Thanks toyou, my grandsoncan charge hisphone now.

lines.speaker: stationery
lines.text: He'sover the moon.
Did you send the robot on its way?

lines.speaker: stationery
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: stationery
lines.text: It maybe somewhat irascible, but

lines.speaker: stationery
lines.text: it workshard, even when ithas a fair bitof wear andtear on it.

lines.speaker: stationery
lines.text: It went outfor its nextdelivery the moment it gaveus our stuff.

lines.speaker: stationery
lines.text: I think it'sstill operating as ifit works atthe construction site.
Construction site?

lines.speaker: stationery
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: stationery
lines.text: When theArk was firstbeing conceived,

lines.speaker: stationery
lines.text: therewere several otherconstruction sites proposed.

lines.speaker: stationery
lines.text: Once the finalsite for the Ark wasdetermined,

lines.speaker: stationery
lines.text: allthe robots responsible forcarrying materials on thejob site

lines.speaker: stationery
lines.text: stopped what they weredoing and headed overthere. Meanwhile, allthe othersites were abandoned.
This robot has experienced quite a few ups and downs.
So people originally considered building the Ark in several other locations?

lines.speaker: stationery
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: stationery
lines.text: The only reasonI know about this isbecause one of the constructionworkers told me.

lines.speaker: stationery
lines.text: At any rate, I consider thisrobot something of afriend. We have a history.

lines.speaker: stationery
lines.text: I just don'twant it to dieduring a delivery.

lines.speaker: stationery
lines.text: Thank you for all yourhelp. Areal weight has been liftedoff my shoulders.

lines.speaker: stationery
lines.text: Bless you, and takecare.
